subject.title: fix(matrix): migrate dedupe from legacy state databases

question: After rebasing, should the Matrix owner accept the non-expiring completion receipt as the one-time migration boundary for historical Matrix roots?
rationale: The receipt intentionally stops future full historical-root censuses, so it is an upgrade-state contract rather than a routine conflict resolution detail.

options.title: Accept after rebased proof
options.body: Resolve the current-main conflicts and land only after the exact merge head demonstrates selective retirement, idempotence, and TTL preservation.

options.title: Require receipt scope refinement
options.body: Keep the migration scan available when historical-root membership can legitimately change after a prior completed pass.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebased proof
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-main conflicts and land only after the exact merge head demonstrates selective retirement, idempotence, and TTL preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete reproduction and exact-head migration evidence, making them the best available technical routing contact while a Matrix-area owner reviews the final contract.
